name: Hero-variants
purpose: Composes/extends the gated Hero baseline into four arrangements (baseline, media, stat-led, CTA-led) without adjudicating whether they become sub-variants of one Hero organism or stay separate. Every headline/intro/CTA/arrow-link markup traces to Hero.reference.html unchanged; the media, stat-led and CTA-led forms add borrowed atoms (Layout-utilities l-split, Stat-card, Button) around it. Itinerary row 118 (Layer 2, NO-ARTEFACT-CLASS at mint; PROPOSED here, not ruled). Do-not-rule: 'Hero component EXISTS — variants compose/extend it, relationship PROPOSED, no adjudication.'

props.name: arrangement
props.$note: Four arrangement variants, VARIANTS-axis prop (s142-D1 class C6). baseline reproduces Hero.reference.html verbatim; media adds a two-column image split; stat-led replaces the CTA row with a Stat-card board; cta-led promotes the single .cta to a primary+tertiary Button pair.

props.name: statCount
props.$note: stat-led arrangement only; the reference draws 3.

variants.name: baseline
variants.use: The gated Hero, unchanged — headline + intro + primary CTA + arrow link on a plain surface.

variants.name: media
variants.use: A landing/marketing page with a supporting photo; text stays OFF the image (Hero's own flagged scrim question stays open, not resolved by this file).

variants.name: stat-led
variants.use: A dashboard-style landing that leads with headline numbers instead of (or alongside) a single CTA.

variants.name: cta-led
variants.use: A hero offering a primary AND a secondary path (e.g. 'Open an account' + 'Compare accounts') rather than one button plus an arrow-link.

tokens.headline: Hero's own raw font shorthand on h1/.intro/.cta, reproduced verbatim — this file does not touch Hero's own type scope
tokens.$note: Every token above resolves through the ATOM's own manifest; this organism binds nothing new beyond arrangement CSS.

responsive.$status: PROPOSED at #210 wave-6 (not ruled) — reflow verified in a real browser at 3 widths.
responsive.rule: media: the two-column split is a CONTAINER QUERY on the wrapping .hv-media element (distinct from the elements it collapses — the hero block and the image — WAVE-5 LESSON 3), single column below 640px container, image promoted above the text. stat-led: the tile board auto-fills 180px+. cta-led: the button row wraps like Hero's own .cta-row already does.
responsive.$note: s210-D3 discipline: no fixed page width is declared anywhere in this file.

mustNotNeighbour: Page-header-lockup in the same slot (a Hero is a marketing banner, not the app's page-header region)
commonPatterns: landing hero with primary + secondary CTA

accessibility.structure: Every arrangement keeps Hero's own single <h1> per page instance; the media arrangement's placeholder image carries role="img" + aria-label (no decorative image is left unlabelled); the stat-led board's tiles keep their own role="group"+aria-label per Stat-card's contract.
accessibility.focus: Every borrowed atom (cta button, arrow-link, Button tiers) keeps its OWN :focus-visible ring — the organism adds no new focusable element and no new focus style.

antiPatterns: Re-drawing the headline/intro/CTA CSS instead of reproducing Hero's own markup verbatim
Inventing a text-over-image scrim treatment — Hero's own header explicitly declines to derive one from tokens; the media arrangement here sidesteps the question rather than answering it
More than one <h1> on the page by nesting two hero arrangements
A third action (arrow-link) alongside the cta-led two-button pair — undrawn territory, not built here

tokenValidation.against: Hero/Layout-utilities/Stat-card/Button's own token manifests, re-declared verbatim by name here
